shortDescription: The Reserve Bank of India likely stepped into the currency market on Wednesday, with the rupee coming under pressure from rising oil prices and dollar outflows, traders said.The rupee FX_IDC:USDINR recovered to 95.07 per dollar following the intervention, after hitting a session low of 95.2250.
